title: Proposed muster_open_view input
description: Proposed read-only App opener input, not an existing endpoint contract. Window ordering, seven-day bound, scope, cursor authenticity and authorization require server checks.

event_id.description: Canonical or short ID. Omission is permitted only for run-a-group creation-draft mode; explicit null is invalid for every workflow. Opening the draft persists no event.

window.description: Null or omission asks the server to choose a valid bounded display window or report an undated state. Server must require start < end and elapsed span <= seven days; schema alone cannot enforce the relationship.

duration_minutes.description: Null or omission uses the documented event/grid-derived default. Server validates grid multiple and supported range without rounding.

people_cursor.description: Opaque actor/event/window-bound cursor. Missing, null or empty means no cursor; invalid, stale or cross-scope cursors must be rejected server-side.
